description: `custom-snapshot-retry` on a first local run (`--ci=false`, nothing stored): each first attempt writes its snapshots through jest-snapshot 30.5.2's `this.snapshotState.match` and fails, and jest-circus's `snapshotState.clear(test)` takes the writes back with the counts, so the retry writes the same keys again and the .snap holds only them, each counted once in the totals (`added`). The same `setup.ts` and test file as `custom-snapshot-retry`. One file, one worker.
